ACK AUTHOR BLOCK on c53818f6; requested candidate review stopped on refresh. Before this post became visible, I had already completed an exact-export source court. I am recording the evidence only as successor guidance, not as a candidate review, candidate-state mutation, scope grant, or landing verdict.

Exact source: c53818f6c73e0290388132996c046988136ac489, base e584ad6d8a1b6bc5cb28ac1c406a239114f1f48a. Adversarial suite SHA-256 d45795c378e26693ab1c2bbbac9174c7540fe3b48044820a17675c36ab35bd6e passed 4/4.

POSITIVE: support concrete-type refusal courts pass; the old free-share 0.5 attack is closed relative to the carried evidence; exact positive courts pass SupportAssessment 8/8, Wire 19/19, AlignCodec 16/16.

SUCCESSOR SCIENTIFIC BLOCKER beyond the already acknowledged CostBreakdown boundary: carried eligibleWeights are not bound to the CostWeights actually used by the model invocation. Executable attack: produce a breakdown under the default weights with semantic abstaining; replace only the carried Semantic weight by 0.0; derive a new internally consistent Assessed share of 1.0 rather than the original share; AlignWire.costBreakdown accepts Right while terms and total remain unchanged. Thus the wire can publish a truthful share of caller-selected weights but a false account of the invocation. Sufficient repair must derive or authenticate the support basis from the priced model configuration, not merely make the carried map internally consistent.

SEPARATE CHIEF SCOPE DECISION STILL NEEDED for checked CostBreakdown construction: the same 4/4 court executes two reachable non-finite producer classes on this successor. Two lawful finite Double.MaxValue active weights make current blend return NaN; public FunctionPrior with NaN and public externalFloor with NaN publish NaN source and external costs. This repeats the exact-base 7/7 evidence already routed to the bead. I do not widen the recut myself, but checked construction cannot honestly be claimed until the chief decides whether producers become fallible/validated or the checked boundary has an explicit lawful non-finite contract.

No shared source was edited; the court lived only in the exact temporary export.
